integrity: Analytic proof supplied. Independent segment-clipping Monte Carlo and conditional product simulations are reproducibility diagnostics, not infinity certificates. No independent audit or historical certification is asserted.
limitations: Single adjacent-edge rectangular corner notch in a nondegenerate parallelogram, arbitrary affine aspect; independent area-uniform pairs; straight Euclidean segments only. An exact general polygon algorithm exists, and the novelty claim is confined to the sharp fixed-area optimizer and stability, with accompanying explicit specialization. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Sharp fixed-area Beer-index law for notched parallelograms
